name: Stellarium
title: Stellarium: free SkySafari alternative
hook: SkySafari Plus charges you twenty bucks to explore the night sky. This app does it for free.
job: Maps every star in your sky

features.intro: It's a real planetarium, right on your computer.
features.say: Over six hundred thousand stars, plus all the planets and their moons.
Turn on constellation art, and the sky fills with illustrations.
Zoom in on nebulas, then speed up time to watch the sky move.

caption:
SkySafari Plus charges $19.99 to explore the night sky. Stellarium does it for free 🔭

✅ Realistic 3D sky with over 600,000 stars, planets and their moons
✅ Constellation art and nebula images from the full Messier catalogue
✅ Zoom in and speed up time to watch the sky move
✅ No subscription, no account, no paywall

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Heads up: it's a desktop app (SkySafari is a phone/tablet app). Stellarium's own mobile app is a separate paid product. SkySafari Plus is $19.99 on sale right now, $29.99 regular
